theme.why: Six Omarchy themes (diva, diva-lavande, diva-menthe, diva-peche, diva-creme, diva-minuit), each with its colours, wallpapers and a glass shell.toml

menu.why: Diva's own French menu, her bar button and her desktop companion, as one Omarchy shell plugin

look.why: Rounded, softly translucent windows, macOS-like touchpad behaviour, glass blur for Diva and the bar, and desktop-wide motion, loaded by one marked require() line in hyprland.lua

screensaver.why: Diva's logo for the screensaver; her own runner (plugin/bin/diva-screensaver) replaces Omarchy's effects

Fredoka.why: The rounded typeface of Diva's menu

wallpapers.why: Twenty-six wallpapers across six themes: photographs, paintings, prints and space

omarchy-marketplace.why: The Extensions page lists plugins from the official catalog and installs them through `omarchy plugin add`

claude-subscription.why: Diva's optional AI assistant (plugin/bin/diva-ai) asks Claude through the Claude Code CLI she signed into in the browser; no API key
needs: Claude Code CLI (`claude`), signed in with `claude auth login`
claude-subscription.alternative: ai.provider = "anthropic" uses the Messages API with a key in ~/.config/diva/api-key

films.why: Films et séries offers YouTube and Netflix as Omarchy web apps and Stremio as its official Flathub app (com.stremio.Stremio), installed per user without sudo

chatgpt-subscription.why: The assistant can run on a ChatGPT subscription instead, through the Codex CLI she signed into in the browser
needs: Codex CLI (`codex`), signed in with `codex login`
